name: Erika
quote: This is a thorny road. I walk it to expiate my sins.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Did you dream of anything last night that requires confession? Sins committed in dreams are not so severe, so you can unburden yourself to me.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It's my manga time now, so please don't bother me if there's nothing important. Or do you imply that you have some other way to ease my boredom?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: A night without sin or malice, a darkness without filth or impurity. Just how did you achieve this?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: At these hours, even criminals ought to be asleep. Just what did you do to be punished, to toil endlessly like this?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Pfft... Hm? Ah, so you were here, Professor. It's nothing; I simply saw something amusing. These manga always helps me to forget those unclean things for a while, and also to recall some precious memories.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Simply confess thy sins, and thou can be saved. Have thine prayers heard, and receive salvation. What a joke...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Are you asleep? Oh leader of the Exiles, Professor of 42Lab... you must have seen countless acts of bloodshed and wrongdoing, yet I can't detect the unclean stench of such acts coming from you... could you be the one that I've been looking for?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Are you heading out? I was just about to head to the firing range to limber up.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Do you want to read this manga? I don't mind if you take it.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Are you itching to get shot?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Careful—the safety's off.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Can we add a production line for gun parts?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Special counsellor reporting. It seems there's nobody here who needs their confessions heard... Oh well, I'm glad to have free time. Please give me a larger room—I have lots of weapons and manga to put in it.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: These bullets... are barely adequate to practice with.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: A fire control upgrade? Good, I like this kind of recoil.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Is this what absolution feels like? Good... allow me to cleanse this world of sin.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: It's time to work. Who needs their confession heard?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I am prepared to listen to their confessions.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Confess your sins!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: The sins of your flesh have been exonerated. May the Lord grant your spirit release.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: The sound of a bullet striking home is as satisfying as the kick of recoil.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: There are still sins... yet to be absolved...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Are you still willing to choose me, despite the sins that I still bear?
I understand. Perhaps you ARE the one I have been waiting for.
Please guide me, so that I may earn my salvation...

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
Professor, stay alert. I hear gunshots outside. Criminals tend to try escaping prison during festive occasions, it seems here's no exception. Is someone at the firing range? No, it sounds like little bundles of explosives... 
You say they're firecrackers? Some kind of oriental custom for ushering in the new year? 
Oh. In that case... Happy New Year, Professor.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: I made a derringer pistol out of chocolate. What do you think? Looks realistic, doesn't it? Few people in the Oasis understand firearms better than I do. The barrel is dark chocolate, while the bullets are filled with liquor... Want to try one? It might hit as hard as a real bullet.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
So these are Tanabata fireworks? They look a lot better compared to my manga.
Although, simply setting off fireworks is kind of boring. Why don't we rig up a Gatling gun that shoots fireworks instead? Mmm... that sounds really cool.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text:
Is something the matter?
You want me to go to a costume ball? Sorry, I'm not interested. Here, take this candy and stop interrupting my manga time.
What's this? Going to play tricks even though you've gotten your treat?
Goodness, what am I going to do with you... Alright then, manga's all the same no matter where they're read. I trust I won't need makeup or a costume?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. I'll be conducting midnight Mass after dinner, so you can come try the bread and wine then. When the bell rings, everyone will receive the mercy and blessings they deserve.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. You seem to be quite well-versed with firearms, so I selected a piece from my collection for you. It's precise, powerful, pretty, and most importantly—it's the same model as shown in "Gunfighter Girl". Well, do you like it?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: These are my favorite guns. One is called Destiny, the other Salvation. Listen, this is the sound they make as they chamber rounds. You didn't think they were simple decorations, did you? I'd like you to hear them firing, if the chance comes up—it's even more marvelous than the sound of them chambering bullets.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: My job? I listen to confessions and grant salvation. I steer people towards righteousness and clean up the mess after the shooting's stopped. Other than that last task, the others are all just for show. When criminals confess their sins, they make themselves sound very innocent, so would they even need a counsellor like me to grant them absolution? They've already absolved themselves in their own minds. Dolls can't forgive their own sins, yet humans can do that easily enough. Oh yes, one more thing. When criminals seek to take justice into their own hands, there is one more thing that I have to do—BANG! Hehe, I didn't scare you, did I?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: They say that I ought to act like a proper preacher. I have to be kind, dignified, fair, saintly and reserved. How many people are really like that in this world anyway? Even a squeaky clean robot is going to grow mildew if you keep it in a filthy cage for long enough. Soaked in sin, bound by logic, stored in dark corners... now, I can smell the evil in a sinner's heart even when I hold my nose. The only way to soothe the frustration in my neural cloud is to cleanse that disgusting stench with my very own hands.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
I was once unaware of my own sins, but after she showed up, I came to realize what pain and suffering truly was. I finally learned the weight of shame and regret, and I realized why she longed for salvation. However... I'm afraid I no longer have any chances to absolve sins any further.
What I do now, I do to try and make up for the past. The past can't be erased, but at least, I have to stop the gears of tragedy from moving any further... don't you agree?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
My neural cloud often replays video data from the past. The people there all look cruel, ugly, and seem to be laughing at me...
Is this the punishment I deserve? All I can do is bear it and carry on—It cannot be washed away or made up for, not even in death. From reality to the cloud server, from the moment I wake until the moment I sleep, all I can do is ruminate on my past sins until someone else comes to absolve me...
Will you be my savior, Professor?

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Boring…

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Huh…

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hah???

career:
The SP-VII was a Doll developed to address the shortfalls of counselling personnel in prisons. This project banked on the stability of a Doll's neural cloud systems to address the psychological stress incurred by prison counsellors. Due to the unique requirements of the job, UAS partnered with Svarog Heavy Industries to produce a brand new version of the SP VII series. This second gen SP VII was jointly designed by sociologists and military engineers; fitted with a comprehensive emotional management suite and powerful military-grade fire control modules, not only allowing it to perform its assigned functions in harsh environments, but to also respond to emergencies requiring armed forces to suppress uprisings.

The SP VII demonstrated professional skills beyond expectations during its practical trials. In addition to its basic counselling duties, the series prototype Erika also quelled multiple riots singlehandedly and achieved satisfactory results when assisting prison management and maintaining order within the facility. After the SP VII Gen 2 model entered mass production, Erika joined Project Neural Cloud as a representative of her line.
infoStories:
Dolls are created to solve human problems, and when humans cannot directly venture into certain environments, machines are always the best alternative. The same thing applies to the vocation of prison counsellors. For humanitarian reasons, certain prisons require professional staff members to listen to the confessions of death row inmates and to perform their last rites. Due to the harsh conditions inside prisons and the need to repeatedly offer guidance to convicts, the task of receiving confessions from convicts soon imposes a significantly negative effect on the human psyche, and the need to deal with the psychological issues that arose within the prison counsellors themselves became a problem of its own. UAS sensed a potential niche, and thus the SP VII was born.

Initially, the SP VII was designed with the personality of a gentle and sympathetic counsellor. The designers anticipated that it would have to deal with intense negative emotions and so they installed a complex emotional processing system as well. However, the SP VII Gen 1 did not perform up to expectations during service trials. Its neural cloud accumulated redundant data far more quickly than expected, causing it to break down frequently. In addition to that, their kindly personality almost enabled an inmate to attempt a prison break. As a result, UAS was forced to issue an emergency recall for all the Gen 1 Dolls in order to optimize and replace them.

With a new project supervisor in charge, the SP VII Gen 2 adopted a completely different design direction. The team named the prototype unit "Erika", and this strong-sounding name foretold a bright new start for her.

Keeping with the service agreement they had signed, the prison which had previously returned the SP VII Gen 1 unit received a new SP VII Gen 2 in exchange. The prison authorities did not expect much of it, to say nothing of the unrepentant criminals incarcerated within the facility. Erika's calm appearance only fueled their defiance further, at least until she applied a baton to a repeat offender trying his old tricks again.

Persuasion, counselling, and when necessary, intimidation—that was the approach UAS and Svarog HI had decided upon during the development process. When dealing with inmates, the fact that Erika was furnished with martial prowess the likes of which the inmates and authorities had never seen before was a clear sign that the development team was catering to the last tenet on their design philosophy. In order to handle the complex prison environment, Erika's emotional modules were downgraded and replaced with brand new riot-suppression techniques. Although cases warranting the use of the latter were not frequent, Erika chose to imprint the meaning of fear into the inmates, probably so she could adapt into the unsavory environment as quickly as possible. 

The truth was that Svarog had only furnished Erika with combat abilities for self-defense purposes, and that UAS had not expected her redesigned personality to immediately resort to such hardline methods. After seeing these unexpected results, the development team thought to recall Erika for adjustments, but the prison authorities denied their requests. To them, a Doll like this was perfect for their needs.

Erika chose to go by her personal name in prison. Her personal idiosyncrasies did not concern the prison management, for what pleased and delighted them was Erika's impressive working efficiency. Though she came off as aloof and standoffish, Erika managed to successfully complete her basic tasks as a counsellor. She showed great patience when receiving confessions from ordinary convicts, and her cool demeanor soothed the death row inmates who were about to serve their final sentence. Her highly-effective handling of recalcitrant convicts which normal counsellors would have been hard-pressed to deal with was also met with the approval of the corrections officers.

With the help of her tremendous martial prowess, Erika began helping the prison guards in corralling prison riots. On many occasions, she quelled such uprisings by herself and successfully maintained order in the prison. She also spotted and rooted out problematic issues with ease, nipping potential uprisings and prison breaks in the bud. Her harsh treatment of the inmates made them realize that Erika was far more threatening than she initially appeared.

Due to her immaculate work performance, Erika was transferred to a desperately short-staffed prison. Her new working environment was filled with even more malignant wrongdoing than before, be it the hypocrisy of the repeat offenders or the hidden dealings within the prison. The prison management was even so corrupt to the point where it interfered with Erika's own work. Erika was at a loss for how to proceed, until she met a certain fragile girl.

In order to support a sick family member, that girl had volunteered to take the rap and go to prison for the crimes of a wealthy criminal. Most thought she would perish without much fanfare in some dark corner of the prison, but the girl was fortunate enough to encounter Erika, who was on duty in that prison. As a prison counsellor, Erika had never once expected that she would be the one being counselled instead, but many things about her had not gone as originally intended, and her relationship with this girl was no exception.
 
After spending some time with this girl, Erika did her best to give this innocent "inmate" all the protection that she could, and with the girl's help she began re-examining herself and her past. She would need a long time to realize what it meant for her to maintain order in prisons, and what the meaning of "prisons" were. Before she could overcome her inner turmoil, a combination of orders from above and her own professional code of conduct gradually limited the aid Erika could give her. Ultimately, Erika could not change that girl's tragic fate.
 
The girl's name is not recorded in Erika's files, or her ultimate fate. According to her service record, Erika requested to be transferred out of the prison after a large scale brawl. She faithfully performed her tasks of listening, counselling and containing uprisings until the day she handed her post over to her successor.

The official reason for Erika's resignation was because the SP VII Gen 2 had entered mass production based on her data feedback, and the prison where she had once served finally received adequate manpower to meet their requirements. As the prototype of the SP VII Gen 2 line and the series' representative, Erika accepted 42Lab's invitation to join Project Neural Cloud. For her, this was intended to sever her ties with her past, while also entailing new possibilities for her.

After arriving at the Oasis, Erika joined the Oasis' field expedition teams by virtue of her great martial prowess.  Just like she had in prison, she maintained her distance from the others, and often fought alone. As time went by, after fighting off the Entropic hordes with her comrades, she eventually chose a new path for herself. In addition to her field work, Erika also helped with the construction of a chapel in the Oasis, where she could often be seen flipping through books in silence.

Apart from Dushevnaya, whom she had grown close to during the invasion of the Oasis, Erika also began making new friends, too. "Clotho, hm... She buries the dead and grants the living a fresh start. Perhaps our jobs might be unexpectedly compatible. I send the sinners to God, and she takes care of their mortal remains." "Sounds like you two would make a great team. Will you lend her your manga too?" Dushevnaya asked innocently.
oathDesc: From this moment on, a new life begins.

projections.name: Confessional Sacrament
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"May your sins be forgiven... Hm? Do you have a problem with this book?"

"May your sins be forgiven... Hm? Do you have a problem with this book?"

projections.name: Penance Tribunal
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Holy ground cannot be profaned. If you seek forgiveness, step forward and I will absolve you of your sins."

skinList.name: Rosy Longinus
skinList.desc:
After accepting her sincere invitation, you spend an unforgettable summer day at the fairground together. Both your heart and hers will always race as you recall your time together.
"You want to compete with me, Professor? Of course I'm game. However, the gods have already revealed the outcome to me—the grand prize will be mine."

skinList.name: Filigree Rose's Incandescence
skinList.desc:
The Dolls change into meticulously chosen outfits, waving goodbye to the last year amidst the sound of firecrackers and worldly delights.
The rose blooms betwixt fierce flames, neither the burning heat or piercing thorns able to conceal the beauty within.
""Do you see how you have transgressed, interrupting my time with the Professor? Hmph, I shall leave it to God to decide your fate.""
